root_idea.summary: A root orientation toward something, often with directed movement and compliance with the direction faced.
root_idea.development: The evidence develops from directing the gaze or neck toward an object to advancing toward it, including the sense of hastening forward.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested active participle is presented under its normalized singular citation form.

senses.definition: With the gaze or neck directed forward toward something; holding a fixed, forward-oriented posture.
senses.usage_conditions: Describes a person or group whose gaze is directed and whose neck or face is held toward the object of attention, as in the Quranic depiction of people with raised heads and an unreturning gaze.

senses.definition: Hastening or pressing forward toward a destination or caller.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in a construction of directed advance, especially with إِلَى meaning “toward”; the hastening expresses the forward-directed posture of the word.

cautions: The supplied Quran occurrences are plural active participles; the public headword is normalized to the singular citation form مُهْطِع.
No Lane primary evidence was supplied, so no additional Classical branches beyond the Quran-attested usages are asserted.
